advice_items.quote: if you've never felt broke before you don't have an healthy enough fear
advice_items.summary_en: Stay hungry and maintain a healthy fear of being broke to keep your edge.
advice_items.summary_zh: 保持饥饿感与对贫穷的健康敬畏

advice_items.quote: you got to do it you got to have the balls to do it now it's a perfect time
advice_items.summary_en: Have the courage to take action when markets reset and assets are down.
advice_items.summary_zh: 克服恐惧并拿出魄力果断入局

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.quote: capital is not needed right now Solutions are go work with lenders go to foreclose single family home
advice_items.summary_en: You don't need capital if you bring solutions to distressed lenders and owners for a profit share.
advice_items.summary_zh: 无需本金，靠帮人解决痛点入局

advice_items.quote: befriend a very wealthy person and be his number two and have him throw you in deals that's the shortcut
advice_items.summary_en: Befriend a very wealthy operator, become their number two, and get brought into deals.
advice_items.summary_zh: 结交富豪并做其二号人物借势起飞

guests.first_money_or_break: 早期靠单户住宅建造项目起步，每周五从ATM取光现金维持周转，靠收取开发费维生并滚动借款做下一笔交易，25岁成为百万富翁，累计完成超200亿美元房地产交易。
guests.wealth_detail: $100M+ peak annual personal income; $20B+ real estate assets transacted
guests.zero_start_advice: 在资产普遍下跌30%-40%的市场重置期果断出手，不需要自有资金也能靠提供解决方案入局：联系贷款机构接手无人愿碰的法拍单户住宅进行托管改造并分取10%利润，或结交富豪做其二号人物带自己入局。

advice_items.quote: branding took me to six figures marketing took me to seven figures systems took me to eight figures
advice_items.summary_en: Scale through stages by building branding for six figures, marketing for seven, and systems for eight.
advice_items.summary_zh: 靠品牌、营销与系统三步实现跃升

advice_items.quote: 1,700 millionaires created every single day... nothing about me fit the millionaire description
advice_items.summary_en: Reject the belief that wealth is reserved for a chosen few; anyone can become a millionaire.
advice_items.summary_zh: 打破自我设限，百万富翁人人可及

advice_items.quote: nobody is coming to save you... it's all on me and every decision is all on you
advice_items.summary_en: Accept that no one is coming to save you and take full responsibility for every decision.
advice_items.summary_zh: 没人会来救你，一切全靠自己担当

advice_items.quote: get a 95 use that money to actually put into the business get those products and make it happen
advice_items.summary_en: Use income from a day job to fund your products, be resourceful, and take immediate action.
advice_items.summary_zh: 用打工本金立即进货创业采取行动

guests.first_money_or_break: 曾做时薪8美元的工作并步行两英里上班甚至晕倒在路边；三次创业破产后，补齐品牌、营销与系统短板，在电商行业实现单年最高970万美元收入并迈入八位数规模。
guests.wealth_detail: $9.7M peak single-year earnings; scaled e-commerce to 8 figures
guests.zero_start_advice: 先找一份朝九晚五的工作，用打工攒下的钱投入生意进货，提升整合资源的能力（resourcefulness），靠自己采取行动改变命运。

advice_items.canonical_tag: Live Below Your Means & Avoid Lifestyle Creep
advice_items.quote: poor mindset make the money spend it on the dinners the cars the the expensive Penthouse
advice_items.summary_en: Stop spending earned income on dinners, cars, and penthouses; maintain financial discipline.
advice_items.summary_zh: 戒掉虚荣消费，拒绝生活成本膨胀

advice_items.quote: invested Into Cash flowing appreciating assets... AKA real estate... and then live off of that cash flow in perpetuity
advice_items.summary_en: Invest earned income into cash-flowing appreciating real estate and live off that cash flow.
advice_items.summary_zh: 把赚来的钱投入产出现金流的房产

advice_items.quote: they have to find whatever their thing is Right find your thing and have a blueprint and a road map
advice_items.summary_en: Find your one core thing, build a clear blueprint, and become the best in the world at it.
advice_items.summary_zh: 选定唯一赛道并制定清晰行动蓝图

advice_items.quote: they're playing checkers not chess... you got to be 15 moves ahead I know what I'm doing month over month for the next 5 years
advice_items.summary_en: Play chess instead of checkers by mapping out your moves month-by-month five years ahead.
advice_items.summary_zh: 像下国际象棋般提前做五年规划

advice_items.quote: you guys think it happens fast and then you don't look at the long term you need to have macro patience and micro urgency
advice_items.summary_en: Don't underestimate how long success takes; pair macro patience with micro urgency.
advice_items.summary_zh: 保持宏观耐心与微观紧迫感忌暴富

advice_items.quote: every single day you give it absolutely everything that you have to give that's how you win
advice_items.summary_en: Give everything you have every single day over many years to win at the highest level.
advice_items.summary_zh: 每天倾尽全力，坚持长期主义积累

guests.first_money_or_break: 深耕戒瘾与心理健康治疗行业长达17年，2021年单年收入突破1亿美元并将企业以超1亿美元出售，同时投资房地产等资产。
guests.role_or_title: Addiction & Mental Health Treatment Founder & Real Estate Investor
guests.zero_start_advice: 找到自己的核心赛道并制定清晰的长期路线图（像下国际象棋一样提前布局未来5年），保持“宏观耐心与微观紧迫感”，并将赚到的钱投入能产生现金流的增值房产，靠其被动现金流生活。

advice_items.quote: we are living in America... everybody can have three jobs and invest and make a deal... if you broke because you want to be broke
advice_items.summary_en: Reject the 'rich get richer, poor get poor' mindset and take advantage of abundant opportunities.
advice_items.summary_zh: 摒弃穷人思维，相信美国遍地是机会

advice_items.canonical_tag: Live Below Your Means & Avoid Lifestyle Creep
advice_items.quote: don't go crazy with the money cuz nothing ever lasts... save your money
advice_items.summary_en: Don't blow your earnings on lifestyle because nothing lasts forever; save your money.
advice_items.summary_zh: 赚钱后切忌挥霍，学会储蓄留存本金

advice_items.quote: mature the business that you're doing do a lot of numbers make sure what is he selling up there
advice_items.summary_en: Know the numbers and unit sales deeply in the business you operate.
advice_items.summary_zh: 吃透所在行业的财务数字与销售逻辑

advice_items.quote: keep thinking about innovating you have to innovate all the time especially now with the Internet with all the apps nowadays
advice_items.summary_en: Constantly innovate and adapt to the internet and new apps to stay relevant.
advice_items.summary_zh: 结合互联网与应用时代保持持续创新

guests.first_money_or_break: 22岁起创业至今（现年47岁），曾单年亏损1200万美元并几乎身无分文，后向兄弟借2500美元在拉斯维加斯押黑连赢三把筹集东山再起的本金，重新投入工作做到单月最高收入55万美元。
guests.wealth_detail: $550K peak single-month earnings; previously lost $12M in one year
guests.zero_start_advice: 破除“穷人越穷”的思维定式，努力打多份工攒钱投资与谈交易；赚钱后切忌铺张挥霍，要吃透所做生意的数字、积极储蓄并紧跟互联网与应用趋势持续创新。

advice_items.quote: get around people who think it's okay to have $500,000 a month in expenses... get around people who do not settle
advice_items.summary_en: Surround yourself with high-spending, ambitious operators who never settle.
advice_items.summary_zh: 靠近高消费高标准、绝不将就的圈子

advice_items.canonical_tag: OTHER:Use Money as a Tool to Grow Earned Income
advice_items.quote: the richest people they're not afraid to use money as a tool to grow their wealth to grow their earned income not only Passive
advice_items.summary_en: Don't be afraid to spend money aggressively as a tool to expand your active earned income.
advice_items.summary_zh: 敢于花钱投资，用钱撬动更多主动收入

advice_items.quote: Brad Lee told me the double R in the headrest stands for recurring Revenue build it
advice_items.summary_en: Focus on building a business model with recurring revenue.
advice_items.summary_zh: 重点打造能够持续产生现金流的订阅制

advice_items.quote: be the man you always needed... my company's based on the fact that I'll never miss
advice_items.summary_en: Be reliable and never miss on your commitments where others only talk a big game.
advice_items.summary_zh: 做当年自己需要的人，说到做到绝不失约

advice_items.quote: nothing in this world is going to work for you you got to work for it... don't take no for an answer
advice_items.summary_en: Nothing works unless you work for it; follow proven paths and refuse to take no for an answer.
advice_items.summary_zh: 天下没有白吃的午餐，必须死磕到底

advice_items.quote: I posted every day on Instagram... I've never missed a post on Instagram or YouTube... greatest marketing tool known to man
advice_items.summary_en: Use social media daily without missing a post as the ultimate free marketing engine.
advice_items.summary_zh: 把社媒作为最强营销工具坚持每日更新

advice_items.quote: I chased something that I really loved and something that I needed I sell what I need I don't just sell anything people will buy
advice_items.summary_en: Build and sell what you genuinely love and need yourself rather than chasing random products.
advice_items.summary_zh: 只卖自己真正热爱且自身需要的产品

advice_items.quote: show me your habits I'll tell you your future... I get up at 2:45... train every day... keep the nutrition on point
advice_items.summary_en: Win the day through strict daily habits like waking early, training daily, and clean nutrition.
advice_items.summary_zh: 用早起、高频健身等日常习惯决定未来

advice_items.canonical_tag: Solve Real Pain Points & Deliver Value
advice_items.quote: being the source of what you see I literally can't live without serving others and that's the gift
advice_items.summary_en: Dedicate yourself to serving others and providing the positive value they need.
advice_items.summary_zh: 全力服务他人，以利他创造真实价值

guests.first_money_or_break: 曾在监狱服刑10年靠吃廉价泡面度日；在狱中便开始发Instagram分享健身与正能量，出狱时已积累1万粉丝并坚持每日在各平台发布内容，最终实现单月290万美元、年入2400万美元。
guests.wealth_detail: $24M peak single-year earnings; $2.9M peak single-month earnings
guests.zero_start_advice: 效仿你想成为的成功人士并坚持不懈，将Instagram和YouTube等社媒作为最强营销工具坚持日更，只卖自己真正热爱且需要的内容；养成凌晨2:45起床和每日健身的自律习惯，靠近高消费高标准的圈子并打造持续性收入（Recurring Revenue）。
